# Browser dependencies

These local copies retain the versions used by the existing interface. They allow the UI to load without runtime CDN requests.

| Library | Version | Source / license |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap | 5.3.0 | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.0 / MIT |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.10.0 | https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.10.0 / MIT |
| Socket.IO client | 4.5.4 | https://github.com/socketio/socket.io-client/tree/4.5.4 / MIT |

Bootstrap Icons font files are under `fonts/`. License notices are retained in the downloaded distributions.
